# Sauce Labs Assembles "New Sauce" Leadership Team to Dominate $1 Trillion Software Quality Market

Thursday, 16 April 2026 10:00 AM

Topic:

#### Company Update

_**Enterprise veterans Steven Fitz and Arun Lal join as Chief Revenue Officer and SVP of Global Marketing, signaling the company's aggressive push to redefine software quality for the AI era**_

**SAN FRANCISCO, CA / [ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / April 16, 2026 /** Sauce Labs, the full-lifecycle AI-quality platform for enterprises, today announced the appointments of Steven Fitz as Chief Revenue Officer and Arun Lal as Senior Vice President of Global Marketing. The hires complete a leadership transformation under CEO Prince Kohli, positioning Sauce Labs to own the rapidly emerging category of intent-driven testing: an AI-native approach the company believes will render two decades of legacy test automation obsolete.

The appointments come as Sauce Labs accelerates an ambitious market repositioning. Early this year, the company launched Sauce AI for Test Authoring, an AI agent that translates business intent into executable test suites, eliminating the manual scripting that has bottlenecked software teams for a generation. The product drew on 8.7 billion real-world test executions, the largest quality dataset in the industry, delivering 90% faster test generation and 99% automatic coverage out of the box. Coupled with the industry's largest test automation cloud and AI-based automated analysis of why tests are failing, what to do about it and when a release is ready to ship, the Sauce AI product suite removes one of the heaviest burdens on software and application development teams.

Now, with Fitz and Lal in place, Sauce Labs is making a clear statement: the company that built the testing industry isn't just evolving it. It's reimagining it.

**A Market That's Been Building Wrong**

The software quality industry generates more than $1 trillion in annual spend, yet the [World Quality Report](https://www.capgemini.com/insights/research-library/world-quality-report-2025-26/) finds that 35% of application functionality still ships untested. [NelsonHall research](https://research.nelson-hall.com/sourcing-expertise/it-services/quality-engineering/) finds that 40% of all test automation effort is consumed by maintenance alone, not catching bugs, but keeping brittle scripts alive. The result: enterprises ship slower, break more, and spend more doing it.

Sauce Labs' thesis is that the problem isn't effort. It's architecture. Legacy testing was designed for a world where humans wrote code at human speed. In the age of AI-generated software, where code is being created orders of magnitude faster than any QA team can validate, the old model collapses.

"Every testing vendor on the planet is selling duct tape for a house that's on fire. We're not here to sell better duct tape," said Prince Kohli, CEO of Sauce Labs. "Steve and Arun aren't joining a test automation company. They're joining the company that's redefining the category."

**Steven Fitz, Chief Revenue Officer**

Fitz is a proven enterprise SaaS operator who has scaled companies through critical growth inflection points. As CRO of Sumo Logic, he grew the business from $40 million to more than $250 million in annual recurring revenue and led the company through a landmark IPO valued at more than $2.5 billion. At Invicti Security, he ran global revenue for an application security testing platform, experience directly relevant to Sauce Labs' category. Earlier in his career he spent over 10 years leading Dell/EMC's NY Metro Division and then Asia Pacific and Japan businesses. A University of Massachusetts graduate based in Austin, Texas, Fitz brings a Fortune 500-tested playbook for converting category leadership into market dominance: the exact motion Sauce Labs is executing.

**Arun Lal, SVP of Global Marketing**

Lal joins Sauce Labs from a career spent at the intersection of enterprise software and category creation. At Microsoft and VMware, he led go-to-market strategy for products such as Software-Defined Data Center, vCloud Suite that redefined how enterprises think about infrastructure and DevOps, turning what had been a back-office function into a strategic capability. He brings a track record of building category-defining narratives that shift how buyers see entire markets, not just products.

Lal's mandate at Sauce Labs is similar: make intent-driven testing the standard every Fortune 2000 engineering leader measures against.

**The New Sauce Labs**

Under Kohli's leadership, Sauce Labs has undergone a fundamental transformation. The company has expanded its vision to solve the end to end quality and monitoring problem in an age of rapid software development and prototyping, enabling fast feedback loops and empowering the shift of a developer to an agent orchestrator. It is helping customers evolve and translate their legacy quality mechanisms to modern AI-native architectures, and has opened new R&D hubs to accelerate development. Sauce AI for Test Authoring has become the fastest growing product for the company out of the gate, with early adopters reporting 38% gains in developer productivity, a 75% reduction in critical production issues, and 46% higher release frequency.

**About Sauce Labs**

Sauce Labs is the world's largest full-lifecycle, test automation platform, and the company behind Selenium and other major test frameworks. Trusted by 80% of the world's top ten largest financial institutions and over 300,000 enterprise users, Sauce Labs provides the only end-to-end AI platform capable of turning business intent into autonomous testing and release assurance. With a proprietary and growing dataset of 8.7 billion test runs, Sauce Labs empowers the Fortune 2000 to bridge the gap between AI-driven code generation and enterprise-grade software quality. Learn more at [saucelabs.com](http://saucelabs.com/).
